chunks: Whoever performs one hundred rakʿahs in the Masjid of Minā before departing from it, it equals the worship of seventy years. And whoever glorifies Allah in the Masjid of Minā one hundred glorifications, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, writes for him the reward of freeing a slave. And whoever declares Allah's oneness therein one hundred times, it equals giving life to a soul. And whoever praises Allah, Mighty and Majestic, therein one hundred times, it equals the reward of the revenue of the two Iraqs spent in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.خَرَاجِ الْعِرَاقَيْنِ: the revenue of the two Iraqs, used here as a measure of immense worldly value
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: in the way of Allah, meaning for His cause
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ مِنًى: the Mosque of Minā, a sacred site associated with hajj rites
key_terms.هَلَّلَ: declared the oneness of Allah by saying words of tahlil

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for prayer and dhikr in the Masjid of Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith extols the immense merit of acts of worship and dhikr in the Masjid of Minā during hajj. It highlights multiplied rewards for salat, tasbih, tahlil, and tahmid performed there, emphasizing the sanctity of the place and the spiritual value of remembrance of Allah.
